title: Dispatch: ug4i.2 level-up spell selection (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-ug4i.2 (level-up spell selection). Read `bd show eshyra-ug4i.2` (its DESIGN field: settled; this description REFINES it and wins where they differ) and `bd show eshyra-ug4i` (decomposition). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-ug4i.2.1, branch eshyra-ug4i.2.1 cut from eshyra-ug4i.2 (main @ 03a7c4d9, which includes eshyra-ug4i.3 / PR #609). Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1.

HARD RULE (srd-fidelity-hard-blocker): never contradict the SRD. Read each class's spellcasting feature prose and progression in packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json before coding. Do not edit records.json, importer scripts, or anything under packages/core/data/rules-packs.

CODE SURVEY:
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpEngine.ts: spellSelectionChoices (the single unsupported blocker to replace), gainsNewSpellLevel, detectLevelUpRequiredChoices, resolveLevelUpChoices (featureChoice branch from #609 is the model), applyChangeSetToSheet / projectToLiveCharacter / syncSpellSlots (unchanged).
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpFeatureChoices.ts (#609): CONDITIONAL_CHOICES (Tome cantrips, Book of Ancient Secrets rituals) currently emit UNSUPPORTED descriptors; make them supported spell descriptors here. Follow its descriptor-id, options, optional, featureChoice and sibling-distinctness patterns (and its newPicks rule: a replacement's first entry is given up, never a pick).
- packages/core/src/character/rulesPackResolver.ts: ResolvedLevelSpellcasting (cantripsKnown, spellsKnown, slots, pactSlots), ResolvedSpellPreparation (kind known|prepared, spellbookStartingSpells, preparationFormula {ability, classLevelDivisor, minimum}), resolveSpell, ResolvedFeatureData.choices.
- packages/core/src/character/finalizeCharacter.ts: CharacterSheet (spells: flat list of names/refs, cantrips mixed in), featureChoices + its validator (model for validating the new field), validateCharacterSheetRollEvidence (where #609 hooked validation).
- packages/core/src/character/requiredChoices.ts + characterDraft.ts: how creation fills sheet.spells (wizard: cantrips + 6 spellbook spells; prepared casters: their prepared list; known casters: known list). Do not change creation in this bead (eshyra-nnj6 owns it; add a note there that creation should write the structured field).
- packages/cli/src/playProgression.ts: the round-based choice collection from #609; spell descriptors must be presentable (option = spell ref + name + level) and must not dump the whole spell list unfiltered: offer the filtered legal list.
- packages/core/src/rules/featureChoices.ts: the `from` object of spell/cantrip choices is a `spellFilter`: classLists (class refs, or "any"), spellLevels, minSpellLevel, maxSpellLevel {classRef, atLevel}, castableLevelsOnly, includeCantrips, ritualOnly, mustBeInSpellbook, mustBePreparedToCast, alwaysPrepared, countsAsClassSpell, countsAgainstKnown, requiresFeatureOption. Spell records carry data.level, data.classes (class NAMES, e.g. "Wizard"; map class ref -> class record name), data.ritual.

DESIGN:
1. SHEET: optional `spellcasting?: { cantrips: string[]; known?: string[]; spellbook?: string[]; prepared?: string[]; mysticArcanum?: { level: number; spellRef: string }[]; designations?: { kind: 'spell-mastery' | 'signature-spell'; level: number; spellRef: string }[] }`, all canonical `spell:<slug>` refs. `sheet.spells` stays the derived union of all buckets, in canonical refs once `spellcasting` exists. Validate the field like featureChoices (shape, refs resolve where a resolver is available, no ref in two of cantrips/known/spellbook), old sheets still load.
2. LEGACY CLASSIFICATION on a sheet without `spellcasting`, at its first level-up: every sheet.spells entry must resolve (refuse the level-up naming the entry otherwise, never guess); level 0 -> cantrips; leveled -> known (spellPreparation.kind known), spellbook (spellbookStartingSpells defined: wizard), prepared (other prepared casters). A non-caster with no spells gets no field.
3. ONE shared spellFilter evaluator: (filter, sheet, class, targetLevel) -> legal spell refs. "Castable" = spell level 1..highest slot level at the TARGET level (warlock: pactSlots.level). maxSpellLevel {classRef, atLevel}: highest castable for that class at atLevel, EXCEPT a repeated grant (Magical Secrets at 14/18) uses the target level (SRD: "A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast"; the pack's atLevel describes the first grant). Unknown filter keys -> the descriptor is emitted UNSUPPORTED naming the key (fail closed, never ignore a constraint).
4. DESCRIPTORS (status supported unless stated; stable ids `level.<n>.spells.<bucket>` or the #609 feature id for feature choices):
   a. cantrips: cantripsKnown delta; the class's own cantrip filter (feature:<class>:spellcasting|pact-magic choice 'cantrips' filter), excluding held.
   b. known casters: ordinary picks = spellsKnown delta MINUS the picks of feature choices granted at this level with countsAgainstKnown true (bard Magical Secrets at 10/14/18: the bard's known growth at those levels IS the secrets). Filter: the class 'spells' filter with castable levels at the target level. Plus OPTIONAL replacement [oldRef, newRef] every level of the class (filter: the class 'spell-replacement' filter; old must be in known and not a Magical Secrets/arcanum pick... SRD: "you can choose one of the bard spells you know and replace it with another spell from the bard spell list" — old must be a known spell of the class list; new from the class list at a castable level).
   c. wizard: spellbook-growth 2 per wizard level (filter on feature:wizard:spellcasting 'spellbook-growth'), into spellbook.
   d. feature spell choices due at this level: any spell/cantrip choice on a feature granted at the target level (class row or subclass) or held whose choice.level === target level (Mystic Arcanum arcanum-6..9 at 11/13/15/17; Spell Mastery at 18; Signature Spells at 20; Magical Secrets 10 and its repeats at 14/18 via the repeated feature ref; College of Lore Additional Magical Secrets at 6; Tome cantrips and Book of Ancient Secrets rituals when the trigger option is picked this level-up or, for a held trigger, never re-asked). Exclude the base spellcasting feature's creation-time choices (cantrips, spells, spellbook-initial) — those are handled by (a)-(c). Persist: magical secrets / tome / book picks into known (countsAgainstKnown false ones still go into known; the field only affects counting); arcanum -> mysticArcanum; spell mastery / signature -> designations (mustBeInSpellbook: from the spellbook).
   e. prepared casters (spellPreparation.kind prepared, incl. wizard): NO blocker. One OPTIONAL descriptor 'prepare' that replaces `prepared` with up to max(minimum, abilityMod + floor(classLevel / classLevelDivisor)) refs (ability modifier from the sheet's final scores at the target level, after any ASI this level-up), filter = the class 'prepared-spells' filter (wizard: mustBeInSpellbook). Preparation is normally a long-rest action; record a follow-up bead for a long-rest prepare tool.
   f. Anything spell-related at the target level the above does not cover -> an UNSUPPORTED descriptor naming it. INVARIANT TEST (generalized, required): for every class in the pack and every level 1->2 ... 19->20, every spell/cantrip feature choice due at the target level (rule (d)) and every cantripsKnown/spellsKnown/spellbook growth produces a descriptor (supported or unsupported); none is silently dropped. Assert by identities (choice ids), derived from the pack, not hand-copied counts.
5. VALIDATION: exact counts; distinct; resolvable; passes its filter; not already held in any bucket (except a replacement's new ref, which must also not be held); sibling distinctness across all spell descriptors of this level-up (the same spell cannot be learned twice by two descriptors); a replacement's old ref held in known.
6. APPLY: update spellcasting buckets and the spells union; ledger change set lists per bucket added/removed refs; syncSpellSlots unchanged.
7. Docs: docs/design/character-progression.md section on spells; engine header comments.

EVIDENCE TESTS (new packages/core/test/levelUpSpellSelection.test.ts; reuse buildSheet/withoutSpellGrowth helpers from levelUpFeatureChoices.test.ts where useful but now with REAL spell growth): bard 1->2 (+1 known, optional replacement), bard 9->10 (2 Magical Secrets from any list incl. a cantrip, 0 ordinary known picks; a 6th-level spell refused), sorcerer 3->4 (+1 cantrip, +1 known; a 3rd-level spell refused at 4), warlock 2->3 with Tome (3 any-list cantrips supported; Chain warlock gets no Tome descriptor), warlock 10->11 arcanum-6 persisted to mysticArcanum, wizard 1->2 (+2 spellbook, 2nd-level refused), wizard 17->18 spell mastery from spellbook, cleric 2->3 (no blocker; optional prepare within the formula limit; over-limit refused), paladin 1->2 (optional prepare, limit CHA mod + 1), ranger 1->2 (2 known), legacy flat sheet classified then leveled, legacy unresolvable entry refuses naming it, the generalized invariant above, and a full level-up chain for one caster (e.g. warlock 1->5 through the real resolver, now that spells no longer block) proving persistence end to end.

VERIFY: npm ci in the worktree, npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. Commit 'eshyra-ug4i.2.1 Level-up spell selection: cantrips, known, spellbook, feature spell choices, optional preparation' ending with 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'.
notes:
Dispatched 2026-10-08 as a Claude Agent (Sonnet 5.5) in .worktrees/eshyra-ug4i.2.1 (branch off eshyra-ug4i.2 @ 03a7c4d9). Codex unavailable.
COMPLETION (commit ba48403e on eshyra-ug4i.2.1; not pushed, no PR).
CHANGES: packages/core/src/character/levelUpSpells.ts (NEW: spellFilter parser+shared evaluator, legacy classification, descriptors, validation, bucket apply); levelUpEngine.ts (spellSelectionChoices + gainsNewSpellLevel removed; wired detect/resolve/preview/apply; LevelUpRequiredChoice.spellChoice, option.level, applied kind 'spell-selection', changeSet.spellSelections); levelUpFeatureChoices.ts (unsupported Tome/Book emission removed, conditional table kept only to mark coverage; descriptorId/selectedOptionIds exported); finalizeCharacter.ts (CharacterSpellcasting, sheet.spellcasting, validateCharacterSheetSpellcasting hooked into roll-evidence validator); rulesPackResolver.ts (ResolvedSpellData.ritual); internal.ts exports; cli playProgression.ts (spell option level display, replace/prepare hints, optional choices asked once); docs/design/character-progression.md; tests: NEW levelUpSpellSelection.test.ts (45), updated levelUpEngine/guidedLevelUpFlow/levelUpFeatureChoices/cli play tests whose old 'unsupported spell blocker' expectations are now supported descriptors.
PACK FACTS VERIFIED (records.json, unchanged): spellPreparation kinds: bard/sorcerer/ranger/warlock known; cleric/druid/paladin/wizard prepared with preparationFormula (wis/1, wis/1, cha/2, int/1; min 1), wizard spellbookStartingSpells 6. Spell records: data.level, data.classes (class NAMES), data.ritual (29 spells, 11 first-level). Bard spellsKnown growth at 10/14/18 is +2 each = the Magical Secrets count (choice countsAgainstKnown true) so ordinary known picks are 0 there. Magical Secrets is granted at 10/14/18 with one choice printed at level 10 (repeat rule = deriveFeatureChoiceInstances: all choices when none printed at that level); Mystic Arcanum granted 11/13/15/17 with one choice per level; Spell Mastery 18; Signature Spells 20; Lore Additional Magical Secrets 6 (countsAgainstKnown false). Warlock slots are pactSlots.level only. Circle of the Land Bonus Cantrip has no structured choice.
DEVIATIONS: (1) Tome/Book/secrets CANTRIPS are stored in cantrips (not known) so legacy classification and bucket-disjointness stay consistent; leveled ones in known. (2) Conditional (Tome/Book) spell descriptors are built in levelUpSpells.ts, not levelUpFeatureChoices.ts (avoids a value import cycle); the list module only marks the feature covered. (3) maxSpellLevel{classRef,atLevel} and castableLevelsOnly are always evaluated at the TARGET level (a choice is made at the target level; equals atLevel for first grants). (4) Spell Mastery/Signature designations choose from the spellbook held BEFORE the level-up; mustBePreparedToCast/alwaysPrepared do not restrict the pick (they describe casting). (5) Replacement old ref = any known leveled spell on the class list; Magical Secrets/Tome/Book picks are not tracked by provenance (follow-up eshyra-3lq2); arcanum is not in known so cannot be replaced. (6) Circle of the Land Bonus Cantrip is an UNSUPPORTED descriptor (fail closed; follow-up eshyra-91o0) so Land druids cannot pass level 2 yet. (7) Expertise (bard 3/10, rogue) remains unsupported (ug4i.1); bard 10 secrets persistence test drops the expertise feature via a test-only resolver wrapper. (8) Preparation uses spellbook plus same-level-up spellbook picks for the wizard; prepare is 'up to N' (1..N).
FOLLOW-UPS: eshyra-odpc long-rest preparation tool; eshyra-91o0 Bonus Cantrip; eshyra-3lq2 pick provenance; eshyra-beor CLI polish; note added on eshyra-nnj6 (creation should write spellcasting).
